2608.03794.title: Evaluating LLMs in Database Scenarios: A Lifecycle Benchmark for Assessing Their Potential in Core Database Tasks
2608.03794.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming database interaction paradigms, evolving from simple query translators to autonomous database administrators (DBAs). However, current evaluation benchmarks remain disproportionately fixated on Text-to-SQL tasks, neglecting the holistic Database Lifecycle-from initial schema design to post-deployment maintenance. This narrow focus fails to capture the diverse capabilities required for real-world database management. To bridge this gap, we introduce DBLifeBench, the first benchmark to evaluate LLMs across five critical lifecycle phases: Design, Implementation, Operation, Debugging, and Maintenance. Furthermore, addressing the cognitive mismatch between ambiguous natural language and complex SQL logic, we propose Progressive-Text2SQL, a novel task utilizing structured reasoning graphs to mimic human iterative problem-solving. Our extensive evaluation reveals a critical insight: while general-purpose models demonstrate balanced performance, specialized Text-to-SQL models suffer from ``catastrophic forgetting'' in non-coding phases like design and maintenance. DBLifeBench serves as a foundational step toward evaluating and building true full-stack database intelligence.
2608.03794.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）正在改變資料庫互動範式，從簡單的查詢翻譯器演變為自主資料庫管理員（DBAs）。<lb/>然而，目前的評估基準仍然過度集中於文本到 SQL 的任務，忽略了整體的資料庫生命周期——從初始的架構設計到部署後的維護。<lb/>這種狹隘的焦點無法捕捉到現實世界資料庫管理所需的多樣化能力。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們推出了 DBLifeBench，這是第一個評估 LLM 在五個關鍵生命周期階段的基準：設計、實施、運行、除錯和維護。<lb/>此外，針對模糊自然語言與複雜 SQL 邏輯之間的認知不匹配，我們提出了 Progressive-Text2SQL，一個利用結構化推理圖來模仿人類迭代問題解決的新任務。<lb/>我們的廣泛評估揭示了一個關鍵見解：雖然通用模型表現平衡，但專門的文本到 SQL 模型在設計和維護等非編碼階段遭遇了“災難性遺忘”。<lb/>DBLifeBench 作為評估和建立真正全棧資料庫智能的基礎性步驟。
